simple.meaning: נֵרְגַּל (Nêrᵉgal) is a Hebrew word meaning “Nergal , a Cuthite deity.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: This word has limited occurrence data, so BibleIQ begins with the Hebrew word, its basic meaning, and the verse where it appears.

definitions.full: H5370. Nergal נֵרְגָ֑ל proper name, of a divinity (Phoenician נרגל CIS i.119. 2 ) — worshipped by men of Cuth, 2Kin 17:30 (see Schr COT 17:30 Jen Kosmol. 476-490 Muss-Arn JBL xi (1892), 168 ).
